actions: thread suspension of every other thread on the first first-chance EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION

answers.freed_object: VirtualAlloc'd page, decommitted (reserved): any read faults; its address is printed as freed_object

non_faulting_probe.expected_result: read failure counted and cited, no exception raised
non_faulting_probe.process: keeps running; the heartbeat advances; exit code 0

faulting_probe.expected_result: handler runs (g_handler_ran >= 1) and suspends other threads: this is the fixture's selftest mode, not a thing a probe may do

answers.debugger_note: the debugger line records IsDebuggerPresent; under a debugger the session context must record the difference
answers.refusal: a probe that cannot be made non-faulting under fault policy 'freezes' is refused, not armed
